channel.title: The Forge — TRE Forged
channel.description: Practical, jargon-free personal finance guides from TRE Forged: budgeting, saving, debt payoff, and getting the most out of Forgenta.

item.title: Credit Utilization Explained: The Fastest Lever to Move Your Score
item.description: Learn how credit utilization works, what ratio to aim for, and the statement-date timing trick that can raise your credit score in as little as one billing cycle.

item.title: How to Negotiate the Price of a Car Without Feeling Intimidated
item.description: Learn practical research, timing, and in-person tactics to negotiate a lower car price confidently at a dealership or private sale.

item.title: Checking vs. Savings vs. Money Market: Which Account Does What
item.description: A clear, beginner-friendly breakdown of checking, savings, and money market accounts and how to use all three together in 2026.

item.title: How to Read Your Pay Stub (and Catch Costly Errors)
item.description: Learn how to read every line on your pay stub, from gross pay to deductions, so you can catch payroll mistakes before they cost you money.

item.title: How to Choose a Budgeting Method That Actually Fits Your Personality
item.description: Stop bouncing between budgeting apps and spreadsheets. Use this personality-based framework to pick a budgeting method you'll actually stick with in 2026.

item.title: The No-Spend Challenge: A Simple Reset for Your Spending Habits
item.description: Learn how to run a 7 to 30 day no-spend challenge, what counts as exempt spending, and how to turn the results into habits that stick in 2026.

item.title: How to Replace a Headlight Bulb in Under 15 Minutes
item.description: Learn how to identify the right bulb and safely swap a burnt-out headlight yourself in under 15 minutes, no special tools required.

item.title: How to Negotiate Lower Bills on Almost Anything (Without Switching Providers)
item.description: Learn exactly what to say to lower your cable, internet, phone, and insurance bills, with real scripts and tactics that work in 2026.

item.title: How to Budget for Car Maintenance and Surprise Repairs (Without Going Into Debt)
item.description: Learn how to build a car sinking fund, know typical maintenance costs by mileage, and avoid the credit-card repair trap in 2026.

item.title: How to Teach Yourself Personal Finance: A Beginner's Roadmap for 2026
item.description: A step-by-step learning path for teaching yourself personal finance in 2026, from tracking spending to budgeting, debt payoff, credit, and investing.

item.title: How to Save for a House Down Payment: Timelines, Targets, and Staying on Track
item.description: Learn how to save for a house down payment in 2026, including realistic timelines, target amounts, the best places to park your money, and how to stay motivated.

item.title: How to Change Your Brake Pads Yourself: A First-Timer's Guide
item.description: Learn how to safely replace your front brake pads at home, including warning signs, tools needed, step-by-step instructions, and key safety checks.

item.title: Should You Pay Off Your Car Loan Early? A Real-Numbers Guide
item.description: Wondering if you should pay off your car loan early in 2026? Compare interest rate vs opportunity cost and see where it fits your debt payoff plan.

item.title: How to Replace Your Car Battery: A Complete Beginner's Guide
item.description: Learn the warning signs of a dying car battery, how to pick the right replacement, and how to swap it safely without losing your car's settings.

item.title: Lease vs. Buy a Car: Which Is Cheaper in the Long Run?
item.description: An honest, numbers-based comparison of leasing, financing, and buying used, so you can pick the option that actually fits your budget in 2026.

item.title: How Car Depreciation Works (and Why It Matters for Your Money)
item.description: Learn why cars lose value, when depreciation hits hardest, and how to buy smarter so you keep more money in your pocket over time.

item.title: The True Cost of Owning a Car in 2026 (Beyond the Sticker Price)
item.description: Learn the real monthly cost of owning a car in 2026, including insurance, fuel, maintenance, registration, and depreciation, so you can budget accurately.

item.title: Car Loans Explained: APR, Terms, and What You'll Actually Pay
item.description: Learn how auto loan APR and loan length affect your total cost, with real numbers, so you can shop the rate instead of just the monthly payment.

item.title: New vs. Used Car: The Smarter Money Choice in 2026
item.description: New or used car? Compare depreciation, reliability, warranties, and total cost of ownership to make the smarter financial choice for your budget.

item.title: How to Save for a Car Without Wrecking Your Budget
item.description: Learn how to set a realistic car savings target, build a timeline, automate your plan, and weigh new vs used tradeoffs without derailing your budget.
